rca of the issue: iter40 root cause: dog_access() denied non-team users -> 403 on /api/dogs/{id} for PRO_COORDINATEUR who hit the pilotage link, and Dogs.jsx did not catch the rejection so React error boundary rendered 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Fix applied on both layers: (1) backend/dogs.py adds `coordinator = user.get('access_level') == 'PRO_COORDINATEUR'` to the allowed read set while write endpoints still require manager or team; (2) frontend/Dogs.jsx openDetail is wrapped in try/catch and shows a French toast on error. Verified curl + Playwright end-to-end in iter41.
